about.heading: About
paragraphs: Hello. I'm a frontend developer who loves making new and fun things.
Rather than settling into the familiar, I enjoy diving into unfamiliar technologies and learning by doing. I care about the delight a user feels even in the smallest interaction.
I aim to communicate clearly with the people I work with, and to keep growing by documenting consistently.

footer.message: Feel free to reach out anytime.

personal-blog.title: Personal Blog
personal-blog.summary: A personal blog and portfolio built from scratch with Nuxt 3.
description: A personal space I designed myself to experiment with and document new technologies.
It supports light/dark mode and a variety of interaction animations.
It is deployed to GitHub Pages as an SPA.

design-system.title: Design System
design-system.summary: A component library and token system for consistent UI.
description: Designed reusable components that can be shared across multiple projects.
Managed colors, typography, and spacing as tokens to improve maintainability.
